payload.fact: Germane cognitive load mediates the relationship between virtual simulation technology (VST) and learning outcomes in accounting education.

decision_note: REJECT, NOT_TRANSFERABLE, delegated by owner. True and grounded, but locked to a domain a product generator cannot act on: the claim is a mediation path measured inside intermediate financial accounting coursework, and its antecedent is an internal load construct rather than anything an interface can set. No manipulable variable survives the move out of the classroom.
